ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (Production.cs:19-22) == cost 0 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new EnergyVar(2)` (Production.cs:13) == `_energy_gain = 2`. `_energy_gain` is in `Card._MAGIC_ATTRS` (cards/base.py:185-189) so `magic_number` surfaces it -- note the sim uses `_energy_gain` here and `_energy` on card/outmaneuver and card/luminesce for the same kind of number; both are in the magic list, so both report.

OnPlay.rationale: `PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(DynamicVars.Energy.BaseValue, Owner)` (Production.cs:26) == `EnergyCmd.gain(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._energy_gain)`. A single-effect card with no guards and no animation on either side. Presentation, folded in: the energy hover tip (17).
